absence_line: St. George Hotel, 2 paces on: Washed ground and mist. The brick hotel is 1860s: 1863 or 1867, the records disagree.
west_point_absence_line: Toward the SSW, 2.3 km off: Sandy Gulch Mine. Not here: Sandy Gulch is 2 miles down the road, south-southwest. The gulch is already being worked; the quartz mills are later.
